# Jayabuddha Agrotech

> Nepal's purest honey producer — offering organic Nepali honey, wild flower honey, forest honey, pure propolis, and fresh royal jelly from our honey farm at Chitwan.

## About

Jayabuddha Agrotech is Nepal's premier organic honey farm and agriculture company, located in Bharatpur-7, Buddhachowk, Chitwan, Nepal. Established in 1992, we have over 30 years of experience producing the finest honey products of Nepal.

We are led by a former Joint Secretary of the Ministry of Agriculture (Government of Nepal) and former Secretary of the Agriculture Ministry of Gandaki Province, bringing world-class agricultural leadership and organic farming expertise.

## Products

### Organic Wild Flower & Forest Honey
Nepal's purest honey — 100% raw, unfiltered organic wild flower honey and forest honey harvested from pristine Chitwan forests and organic farms. Rich in natural enzymes, antioxidants, and pollen. Our honey is never pasteurized, heated, or adulterated.

### Pure Propolis Extract
Pure propolis — nature's powerful immune shield. Carefully collected from Chitwan beehives, our propolis retains full antimicrobial, antiviral, and bioflavonoid-rich healing properties. Used for immunity boosting and natural health.

### Fresh Royal Jelly
The queen bee's exclusive superfood. Our fresh royal jelly is rich in 10-HDA, essential proteins, B-complex vitamins, and vitality-enhancing nutrients for cellular regeneration and cognitive health.

### Organic Bee Pollen
Nature's complete superfood with over 250 active bioavailable nutrients, proteins, and amino acids. Harvested from organic bee farms in Chitwan, Nepal for daily vitality and energy.

### Farm Fresh Lemons
Organically grown lemons harvested directly from our own citrus orchard in Bharatpur, Chitwan. Packed with Vitamin C and natural zest.

### Nursery Saplings
Healthy, high-yielding fruit saplings, citrus trees, and bee flora plants cultivated under expert agricultural supervision at our nursery in Bharatpur, Chitwan.

## Services

### Agricultural Training
Comprehensive training programs for farmers and students covering modern apiculture, organic farming techniques, sustainable agriculture practices, and hands-on beekeeping field research.

### Soil Testing & Analysis
Scientific soil composition analysis — NPK nutrient levels, pH balance testing, and soil health assessment for crop yield optimization in Chitwan and across Nepal.

### Agriculture Planning
Strategic farm design and land management plans tailored to local climate conditions, crop rotation cycles, and long-term economic sustainability for farms of all scales.
